## What

Closes #NNN (the task issue). One sentence.

## Checklist

- [ ] Automated tests listed in the issue exist and `uv run pytest -q` passes locally
- [ ] Docs listed in the issue updated (`docs/`, `README.md`, `AGENTS.md`)
- [ ] Task file in `docs/issues/` updated if the scope changed; `scripts/issues_sync.py lint` passes
- [ ] Project card moved to *Review*
- [ ] Manual test from the issue run; result pasted below
- [ ] No real personal data, work data or secrets (synthetic / fictional only)
- [ ] `uv run pre-commit run --all-files` passes

## Manual test result

Paste the observed output / screenshot description.
